captions.short_caption: The Soyuz MS-09 rocket launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan
captions.caption: The Soyuz MS-09 rocket launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan on 6 June 2018, taking the Expedition 56 crew to the International Space Station (ISS). The crew consisted of Soyuz Commander Sergey Prokopyev of Roscosmos, flight engineer Serena Auñón-Chancellor of NASA, and flight engineer Alexander Gerst of ESA (European Space Agency).
captions.alt_text: A Soyuz rocket clears the launch tower, taking a crewed Soyuz spaceship to the ISS.
